item.title: Compass Coffee’s sudden closure in College Park surprises UMD students
item.description: The café shuttered during the university’s winter term after its parent company filed for bankruptcy and requested to close at least 10 of its 25 stores.

item.title: Another storm, another infrastructure breakdown at UMD
item.description: From this winter storm to having students sleep on the floor during a heatwave, students are paying far too much in tuition to receive so little in times of crisis.

item.title: Emerald Fennel’s ‘Wuthering Heights’ is more of a parody than an adaptation
item.description: With overly eroticized scenes and a failing screenplay, the movie relies on its cast and mockery of emotional chemistry to keep the viewer enticed.

item.title: Maryland men’s lacrosse suffered an early-season loss to an elite team. Does it matter?
item.description: History suggests the Terps can recover from the loss, which knocked them out of the nation's No. 1 spot.

item.title: Charli xcx captures gothic romance, ‘brat’ energy in ‘Wuthering Heights’ soundtrack
item.description: 'Brat' summer may be over, but 'Wuthering Heights' winter has arrived.

item.title: UMD must declare itself a sanctuary campus
item.description: The university cannot claim to value student safety and democratic engagement if they ignore thousands of students calling for institutional protection.

item.description: First-year graduate opera students performed the new show in Gildenhorn Theatre on Friday.

item.title: How Maryland gymnastics uses exhibitions to repair flawed routines, player confidence
item.description: The exhibitions don't count toward the Terps' team score, but help gymnastics build confidence.

item.title: UMD Dining Services, Muslim Student Association prepare accommodations for month of Ramadan
item.description: As Ramadan is set to begin on Tuesday at dawn, students observing the holiday are preparing for a month of prayer, fasting and reflection.

item.title: Here are 4 higher education bills to look out for in the Maryland General Assembly
item.description: Lawmakers hope to set consistent policies for Naloxone use, protect students from being doxxed online and require that schools have Title IX coordinators.
